description: Look up a real on-chain deal by its 0x deal id. Returns state, parties, amounts, deadlines and who can act next. An unknown id returns not_found. Not for sandbox ids; use sandbox_get_deal for those. Read-only.

chain.description: Must match this process. Defaults to the configured chain.

escrow.description: Defaults to v2. v1-legacy is read-only and only on Arbitrum One.

name: get_deal_status
title: Read deal status
